package.description: Fast interactive htop-like process monitor and system resource viewer for Windows

en-US.description: Fast interactive htop-like process monitor and system resource viewer for Windows
en-US.longDescription:
A native Windows clone of htop - the beloved interactive process viewer, rebuilt from the ground up in Rust.
Features real-time per-core CPU usage, memory and swap meters, D3DKMT GPU and Copilot+ NPU meters matching Task Manager, 27 sortable columns, tree view, search and filter, EcoQoS (Efficiency Mode), and full mouse navigation.
en-US.name: htop-win
